text: Traditional jurisdictional principles cannot directly apply to blockchain technology because the blockchain is merely a collection of agreed upon calculations by decentralized computer systems, and no particular node holds the entire blockchain.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain-Based Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3441904
abstract: Traditional jurisdictional principles cannot directly apply to blockchain technology because the blockchain is a mere collection of agreed-upon calculations by decentralized computer systems.

value: public decentralized blockchains maintained by anonymous global users
